### Christ the Builder
Author: Truth For Life (adapted by Alistair Begg from C. H. Spurgeon)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-22-2019.html
Passage: Zechariah 6:13
Points:
- Jesus Christ Himself is the builder and foundation of His spiritual temple.
- Individual believers are like rough timber and quarried stones needing divine preparation.
- Earthly afflictions and trials are tools Christ uses to shape and sanctify His people.
- All the labor of sanctifying and shaping believers occurs during this earthly life.
- Once prepared, believers are brought safely into the heavenly Jerusalem to stand as eternal pillars.

### The Priestly Branch on the Throne
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/priestly-branch-throne
Passage: Zechariah 6:9-15
Points:
- Placing a royal crown on High Priest Joshua foreshadows the Messiah uniting priestly and royal offices.
- The title "the Branch" points past Joshua to the future Davidic king who builds the true temple.
- Jesus fulfills this prophecy as the Priest-King who reigns in majesty and intercedes for His people.
- Christ constructs His spiritual temple, the church, upon the apostles with Himself as the cornerstone.
- The inclusion of people from far away highlights the calling of Gentiles to help build God's house.
